description: Polish app/booking/page.tsx layout and timeout modal to elite standard: add dark breadcrumb bar, page title section with slate-900 bg and emerald border, upgrade grid layout (sidebar sticky top-28), and redesign timeout modal with high-contrast red-600 styling and darker backdrop
steps: 1. Modify app/booking/page.tsx page wrapper and structure: Change page bg to slate-100 (not slate-50). Below Header, add dark breadcrumb bar: slate-800 bg, py-3, border-b border-slate-700, 'Home › Appointment Booking' in slate-300 text-xs. Add page title section: slate-900 bg, py-6, border-b-4 border-emerald-600, centered 'OPD Appointment System' (text-2xl, font-bold, white) + subtitle 'Complete all steps to secure your digital queue pass.' (text-slate-300, text-sm). Keep existing grid layout but update: max-w-7xl mx-auto, gap-6, py-8, left sidebar (1/3) with sticky top-28 (not top-24), right content (2/3) with white card border border-slate-300 rounded-sm shadow-lg p-8.

2. Upgrade timeout warning modal in app/booking/page.tsx: Keep existing logic (showTimeoutWarning state, 9min warning + 1min countdown, activity tracking). Visual changes: backdrop bg-black/60 (darker), modal card max-w-lg border-t-[6px] border-red-600 (thicker) rounded-sm shadow-2xl p-8, red-600 circle icon bg-red-100 text-3xl, title 'Session Timeout Warning' (text-xl font-bold slate-900), countdown display bg-red-600 (not red-50) white text text-6xl font-mono font-black py-6 rounded-sm 'seconds remaining' (white text-sm), buttons: 'Continue Session' emerald-700 hover:emerald-800 white uppercase font-bold py-3, 'Exit' slate-300 border-2 hover:bg-slate-50 uppercase. Keep all existing timeout logic, navigation guards, and state management unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Booking page shows slate-100 bg with dark breadcrumb bar and slate-900 title section with emerald bottom border
Grid layout maintains 1/3 sidebar (sticky top-28) and 2/3 content card with proper spacing
Timeout modal appears after 9 minutes with high-contrast red/white styling, dark backdrop, and thicker red top border
All existing timeout logic, navigation guards, and booking flow state management work unchanged
TypeScript compilation succeeds and responsive layout works on all viewports
verification: Run 'npm run build' - must complete with 0 TypeScript errors
Run 'npm run dev' and navigate to /booking - confirm slate-100 bg, dark breadcrumb, slate-900 title section, and 1/3 + 2/3 grid layout
Test navigation guard: select a category, click browser back button - confirm 'unsaved changes' alert appears
Wait 9 minutes (or temporarily reduce WARNING_TIME for testing) - confirm timeout modal appears with red-600 accent, white countdown on red bg, and emerald/slate buttons
Click 'Continue Session' in modal - confirm modal dismisses and booking flow continues
